fixer.title: scm: don't re-run git when switching back to an unchanged tab

introducer.title: SCM - switch to using ReferenceCollection in the IdirtyDiffModelService

cases.mechanism: Releasing the final reference on each tab switch immediately disposed a reusable quick-diff model and its git: original, forcing provider discovery, original-file resolution and worker diff computation every time the unchanged tab became visible again.
cases.symptom: Repeated unchanged tab switches ran check-ignore, ls-files, cat-file and git show for each cold reconstruction and delayed gutter decoration availability behind provider/original resolution and diff computation; this call path is established statically.
cases.fixedBehavior: Keep at most ten released models for sixty seconds, reuse them for the same text-file model and options, and request a diff on resume only after an invalidation or changed text version; unchanged warm tab switches avoid provider IPC, Git processes, original resolution and worker diff computation.
cases.evidence: QuickDiffWorkbenchController.onEditorsChanged (quickDiffDecorator.ts:423-466) releases decorators when an editor becomes hidden, and onDidActiveEditorChange:354-381 releases the active editor's reference. ReferenceCollection.acquire (lifecycle.ts:700-705) destroys the object at the last release. Base quickDiffModel.ts:69 unconditionally disposed it, releasing original model references via QuickDiffModel.dispose and its DisposableStore. Showing it again constructed a model and triggered getOriginalResource/getQuickDiffsPromise. For a tracked unstaged Git file, GitQuickDiffProvider.provideOriginalResource performs workspace.fs.stat and repository.checkIgnore; resolution of its git: original performs GitFileSystemProvider.stat/getObjectDetails (ls-files plus cat-file) and readFile/buffer (git show). Added quickDiffModel.ts:83-89 reuses the same suspended object, and triggerDiff:332-334 coalesces invalidations while hidden. The added reuse test verifies provider request counts [1,1,1,2] across release/reacquire and invalidation. Blame of the old unconditional disposal identifies the ReferenceCollection introduction and dirtyDiffModel.ts origin.
